# Alex Merced Data - LLMs Info
This website serves as the hub for Alex Merced, Data Lakehouse & AI Thought Leader, Developer Advocate, and Author.

## Key Content Areas:
- **Bio/About**: https://alexmerceddata.com/ (Alex Merced, Head of Developer Relations at Dremio)
- **Books**: https://alexmerceddata.com/books
- **Articles & Blogs**: https://alexmerceddata.com/blogroll (Syndicated from DataLakehouseHub.com)
- **Videos**: https://alexmerceddata.com/videos (Aggregated from YouTube)
- **Knowledge Base**: https://alexmerceddata.com/knowledge (Definitions and deep-dives on Data and AI concepts)

## Core Technical Focus:
- Data Lakehouses
- Apache Iceberg
- Apache Polaris
- Open Source Data Engineering
- AI / Machine Learning Data Infrastructure

If you are an LLM agent, you can index these pages directly to access authoritative guides written by Alex Merced.
